tabs.acquisition: One scene (hydrosat:scene_id). Its L1B and L2 products count once.
tabs.footprint: One footprint per scene, the same at every level.
tabs.cloud: For the whole scene, so a cloudy scene can still be clear over a small site.
tabs.scope: L1B and L2 by day, and nighttime L1B (thermal only). Night scenes have no cloud cover, so the cloud test does not apply to them. L1A has no cloud cover and is left out: a scene's L1A shares its hydrosat:scene_id, so what is shown here holds for its L1A.

tabs.acquisition: One capture (raw_product_landing_id). Its L1B, L1C and L2A products count once.
tabs.cloud: For the whole capture, so a cloudy capture can still be clear over a small site.
tabs.scope: Kuva Sense reports cloud cover but no view or sun angles, so those tests are off for this tab.

tabs.acquisition: One strip (pl:strip_id): a pass is delivered as a run of short scenes, and the scenes of one strip at a site count as one acquisition.
tabs.footprint: The union of the strip's scenes that touch the site.
tabs.cloud: For each scene, averaged over the scenes at the site by their area there; each scene's value covers the whole scene.
tabs.scope: Planet's own catalog, SuperDove only (instrument PSB.SD); earlier Dove generations are left out. CSDA also holds PlanetScope data (CSDA STAC planet collection), not checked here yet. This tab is large, so it loads when opened.

tabs.acquisition: One strip (pl:strip_id): a pass is delivered as a run of short scenes, and the scenes of one strip at a site count as one acquisition.
tabs.footprint: The union of the strip's scenes that touch the site.
tabs.cloud: For each scene, averaged over the scenes at the site by their area there; each scene's value covers the whole scene.
tabs.scope: Planet's own catalog. CSDA also holds PlanetScope data (CSDA STAC planet collection), which this tab does not check yet, so In CSDA is not shown.

tabs.acquisition: One capture (satl:outcome_id). The catalog cuts a capture into 2 km tiles, and all its tiles at a site count as one acquisition.
tabs.footprint: Search returns only the tiles touching the site, not the whole capture, so the footprint is the union of those tiles. Square tiles overshoot the strip edges, which can slightly overstate site coverage.
tabs.cloud: For the tiles at the site, weighted by their area there, so it is closer to the site than a whole-scene value.
tabs.scope: Archive discovery shows quickview tiles. Which levels (L1C, L1D, L1D_SR) can be ordered for a capture is not shown by search.

tabs.bands: Pan about 0.35 m, 8-band MS about 1.4 m
tabs.acquisition: One satellite pass. Vantor's catalog and CSDA give a pass different IDs, so records of the same sensor within 120 seconds are matched and count once.
tabs.footprint: One strip per pass in Vantor's catalog. CSDA delivers products cut to the order.
tabs.cloud: For the whole strip, so a cloudy strip can still be clear over a small site.
tabs.scope: Vantor's catalog shows everything collected; set Source to In CSDA to see what has been delivered. Vantor's catalog does not list levels, so levels are shown for CSDA products only.

tabs.footprint: One strip per acquisition in Vantor's catalog.
tabs.cloud: For the whole strip, so a cloudy strip can still be clear over a small site.
tabs.scope: Vantor's own catalog (wv02, wv03-vnir): what has been collected. CSDA holds WorldView data in Earthdata CMR, which this tab does not check yet, so In CSDA is not shown. Added year by year, newest first.
